text: A standard objection to the coherence theory of truth is that:
choices: it cannot explain why '"snow is white" is true' is equivalent to 'snow is white.'
it wrongly makes truth depend on correspondence to sui generis facts.
it entails that truth is recognition-transcendent and mind-independent.
multiple mutually incompatible belief systems can each be internally coherent, so coherence fails to single out a unique set of truths.
explanation: The plurality objection: since more than one comprehensive system can be internally coherent while contradicting another, coherence alone cannot determine which system is the true one. Distractor 2 is backwards, since coherentism makes truth internal to a belief system rather than recognition-transcendent, and distractor 1 misattributes a correspondence commitment to a theory designed to avoid it.
